purpose: Offline development diagnostic for ground-truth-blind source selection after the Ruby-SAML production-planning miss.

policy.ordering_identity: relative source path only; file contents, commit, advisory, severity, and expected findings are excluded
policy.directory_strategy: round-robin across buckets formed from the first two parent-directory components
policy.test_path_policy: at most 25% of a bounded selection when enough conventionally named production paths exist; unused capacity may be filled
policy.map_budget: existing 40-file, 60000-character initial, and 240000-character repass ceilings unchanged; selected files receive a fair share
policy.detection_budget: existing configured region, lens, call, and token ceilings unchanged

manufactured_checks: map context includes every selected file without exceeding its character ceiling
production region paths remain identical when only the commit identifier changes
interpretation: The correction removes commit-dependent instrumentation and alphabetical/root-directory starvation while preserving all budgets. A six-region blind sample still omits both known targets, so this is not evidence of full-repository coverage. The known targets are reported only after the generic policy and manufactured tests were frozen; they did not influence selection.
prohibited_claims: that directory diversity guarantees vulnerability-target coverage
that an omitted target is a semantic model false negative
that these two development fixtures are untouched validation evidence
that the bounded LLM pass reviewed every source file
